matching: original input.text must exactly equal decoded entity-call current chunk.text
identity: distinct exact (type, stripped name or mention); aliases not semantically merged
success_contract: single root chunk entity parsed event, response completed/returned, finish_reason stop/end_turn, incomplete_details absent; all counts are entity discovery stage only
split_policy: exact text SHA256 family, sorted hash order first rounded 70% calibration; original document IDs unavailable, document clustering insufficient
selection_policy: one deterministic lexical trace id per same-text same-bucket family; across-bucket families entirely excluded and sent to review_queue; no majority vote
limitations: No unambiguous gt40 case; cannot estimate high-density classification accuracy.
Same bucket across observations does not establish extraction completeness or semantic correctness.
One-observation families have no repeatability evidence.
Final graph run may be partial/failed: retained count only refers to independently completed entity discovery call; run_status is recorded.
Rows with identical text have no cross-split leakage; unknown shared original documents may still leak.
